project_name: SHARPMARKET / 0xSHARP (Polymarket Sports & Esports Smart Money Terminal)
design_archetype: The Tactical Trading Terminal (Swiss High-Contrast + Dark Mode Precision)
emotional_tone: Technical, razor-sharp, analytical, high-conviction, disciplined alpha without fluff

hierarchy.h1_terminal_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tight uppercase
hierarchy.h2_section_heading: text-lg sm:text-xl font-mono font-semibold tracking-normal uppercase text-zinc-100
hierarchy.h3_card_title: text-sm sm:text-base font-mono font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-300
hierarchy.metric_label: text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-zinc-400
hierarchy.badge: text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold uppercase px-2 py-0.5 tracking-wider

rules: Never use Inter for headlines or badges. Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric tables, meters, wallets, and badges.
Tabular figures ('tabular-nums font-mono') are mandatory on every price, volume, percentage, score, and address.
Keep uppercase labels with generous tracking: 'tracking-widest text-[11px]' to signal command-center status.

SHARP.desc: High winrate, high ROI, positive expected value (+EV) bettor with strict edge

WHALE.desc: Massive position size ($50k+), moves orderbook depth and creates slippage

INSIDER_EARLY.desc: Enters hours before roster/injury leaks or pre-event line movement

MARKET_MAKER.desc: Two-sided liquidity provider, high frequency delta-neutral rebalancing

BOT.desc: Automated contract execution, sub-second snipe of odds discrepancies

SCALPER.desc: Rapid turnaround, exits before resolution to lock 2-5% tick spreads

RETAIL_NOISE.desc: Recreational, sentiment-driven underdog chasing or home-team bias

layout_and_grids.container_type: Mode B: High Density Trading Terminal with 1px hairline grid borders
structure: 1. Global Top Bar / Ticker: Live aggregate stats (Tracked Smart Volume, Sharp Bias % Yes vs No, 24h Resolved Markets, Active Bot Volume, Gas/Polygon status)
2. Primary Viewport Header: Market Sport Selector (ESPORTS primary with sub-pills: CS2, LoL, Dota2, Valorant; then Traditional: NFL, NBA, Premier League, UFC, Tennis)
- Left Panel (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8): Markets Heatmap / Dense Table with Smart Money Strength Dual-Gauges (Yes vs No), Capital Split bar, Resolution Countdown, and 1-Click Detail Expand
- Right Panel (col-span-12 lg:col-span-4): Deep Market Inspector (when market selected) OR Live Sharp Money Feed Tape (when browsing)
- 'Sharp Leaderboard' (Ranked by Smart Score 0-100, Winrate, Hold-to-Resolution %)
- 'Wallet Classifier Lab' (Inspect any address, see Bot vs Sharp diagnostics, Hold-to-Resolution radar)
- 'Esports Deep Alpha' (Matchup odds vs Sharp book discrepancies)
layout_and_grids.border_style: 1px solid #1E2633 with crisp nested boxes. Zero bubbly rounded corners; maximum rounded-sm (2px to 4px) to respect anti-predesk preference.
layout_and_grids.density_scale: Padding p-2 to p-4 inside data cells; tight gap-2 or gap-3 with clear visual hierarchy.

smart_money_gauge.visual: Dual-sided horizontal differential bar: Left = YES Smart Score with neon green glow; Right = NO Smart Score with coral red glow. Center indicator flags the 'Net Alpha Lean' (+24 YES LEAN).

wallet_classification_badge.description: Monospace pill with category color stroke and micro icon indicator (e.g., ⚡ SHARP, 🐋 WHALE, 👁️ INSIDER, ⚙️ BOT, ⏱️ SCALPER, ⚖️ MM, 👤 RETAIL).
wallet_classification_badge.interaction: Hover opens popover with instant wallet stats: 30D PnL, Winrate, Hold-to-Resolution %, Total Bets.

capital_flow_breakdown.description: Multi-segmented color bar representing capital split across wallet types (e.g. 42% Sharp, 25% Whale, 18% MM, 15% Retail).

hold_vs_exit_radial.description: Comparison indicator showing % of capital committed that holds to market resolution (high conviction) vs dumped early (scalper/panic exit).

ai_analyst_narrative.description: Terminal-style intel wire: 'SMART MONEY INTEL: 4 Tier-1 Sharp wallets entered YES @ $0.48 after roster update. 82% hold-to-resolution historical bias.'

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow dark mode trading terminal aesthetic: deep obsidian/slate canvas (#07090E, #0D1117), crisp 1px borders (#1E2633), high-contrast data rendering.

Esports is the flagship market: seed rich realistic Esports markets (League of Legends Worlds, CS2 Major Copenhagen, Dota 2 The International, Valorant Champions, Rocket League RLCS) alongside high-stakes sports (Champions League, NBA Finals, Super Bowl, UFC).
Implement the Smart Money Strength algorithm explicitly: calculate Score out of 100 based on ROI, Hold-to-Resolution %, Win Rate, and PnL.
Implement comprehensive Wallet Classifications: Sharp, Whale, Insider/Early-Mover, Market Maker, Bot, Scalper, and Retail/Noise.
Every wallet in the detail view and leaderboard must display its classification badge, hold-to-resolution ratio (e.g. '88% Holds to End' vs 'Exits early in 2.1h'), winrate, and total volume.
Provide interactive tabs: 'Markets Grid', 'Sharp Leaderboard', 'Wallet Diagnostics / Classifier', and 'Esports Alpha Feed'.
Ensure every button, tab, card, input, and table row has its corresponding data-testid attribute from the manifest.
Ensure responsiveness: on mobile, convert wide tables into dense high-utility cards with preserved gauges; on desktop, utilize the full widescreen command deck.
